title: Percentage Yield Calculation
body: In an experiment, 10 g of calcium carbonate (CaCO3) was heated to produce calcium oxide (CaO) and carbon dioxide (CO2). The equation is: CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2. The actual yield of CaO was 4.8 g. Calculate the percentage yield. (Molar masses: Ca = 40, C = 12, O = 16)
